👋 😊 📢 Welcome! You are invited to participate in a research survey on blended learning. Blended learning is an educational approach that combines traditional face-to-face classroom methods with online learning activities. This survey aims to understand your experiences and perceptions to help improve this learning method for greater efficiency and flexibility. The survey is anonymous and will take approximately 10-15 minutes to complete. Your participation is greatly appreciated.

gower_hierarchical.interpretation_note: Gower distance with hierarchical clustering is retained as an exploratory validation approach rather than the main segmentation model. The final thesis segmentation remains based on K-Modes because it is simpler to deploy and easier to align with categorical student profiles.

tech_issues_freq.description: Reverse-coded because higher original values indicate more frequent technical issues.

tech_issue.title: Improve technical access and reliability
tech_issue.recommendation: Provide stable internet access, offline materials, clear platform instructions, and technical support.

motivation.title: Support motivation and self-discipline
motivation.recommendation: Use weekly check-ins, reminders, progress tracking, and structured study schedules.

interaction.title: Increase interaction and communication
interaction.recommendation: Add Q&A sessions, group discussion, peer collaboration, and faster lecturer feedback.

learning_support.title: Improve clarity and learning support
learning_support.recommendation: Provide clearer instructions, examples, recorded explanations, and step-by-step learning guides.

learning_environment.title: Improve learning resources and environment
learning_environment.recommendation: Organize materials clearly, update resources, improve study spaces, and support classroom comfort.

workload_support.title: Manage workload and assessment pressure
workload_support.recommendation: Balance assignments, clarify deadlines, and align online tasks with in-person sessions.

self_paced.title: Support self-paced learning
self_paced.recommendation: Provide recorded lessons, weekly learning paths, and materials students can review at their own pace.

content_access.title: Strengthen access to learning materials
content_access.recommendation: Upload slides, videos, references, exercises, and course materials early.

digital_skill.title: Develop digital learning skills
digital_skill.recommendation: Provide guidance on LMS tools, online resources, digital research, and educational technologies.

engagement.title: Increase learner engagement
engagement.recommendation: Use quizzes, games, practical tasks, discussions, and interactive activities.

learning_effectiveness.title: Improve learning effectiveness
learning_effectiveness.recommendation: Combine online review materials with in-person explanation, practice, and feedback.
